mirdif.desc: Bonbird is a homegrown UAE fried chicken brand from Yolk Brands, the team behind Pickl. We serve bone-in chicken, tenders, chicken burgers, melts and wraps, made fresh to order and never frozen, with no hormones, no antibiotics and no preservatives. Our chicken comes in six flavours, from Plain Jane to Nashville-style XXX Hot, with sides like Chicken Salt Fries and Mac and Three Cheese. You'll find us inside Mirdif City Centre on Level 1, beside the North Food Court. Dine in, take away or order delivery on Talabat, Deliveroo, Noon and Keeta. All Bird. No Bull.
